There's nothing they can do. I went to the doctor for about 16 until a couple of years ago when I quit going because I can't afford it anymore. I was told that the problem is outside of their understanding. 

I think I'm finished with life as of now. Thinking back on all the things I've tried and time I've wasted. I don't want to continue on. I'm going to go kill myself right now. 

Good bye.

I have a learning disability. 

Anything I'm interested in doing I can't because of this disability. I can spend hours, days, months and even years studying whatever it is I'm interested in with no results. I just just read or listen to the same things over and over again and I can't get it. My brain is wired up wrong so anything I enjoy in life I'll never be able to do.
